description: This source file defines the class CanvasController, which manages a WebView component to capture and render canvas snapshots, handle navigation, debug status, and state synchronization within an Android app.

classes.name: CanvasController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing a WebView for canvas snapshotting, navigation, and debug information display, with support for image encoding and state updates.

methods.name: attach
methods.description: Associates a WebView with the controller and initializes the view with current state and debug info.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Disassociates the WebView from the controller.

methods.name: navigate
methods.description: Navigates the WebView to the specified URL, or loads the scaffold if URL is null or blank.

methods.name: currentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current URL being viewed in the WebView.

methods.name: isDefaultCanvas
methods.description: Checks if the current URL is null, indicating the default canvas state.

methods.name: setDebugStatusEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables debug status overlay in the WebView.

methods.name: setDebugStatus
methods.description: Sets the title and subtitle for debug status overlay.

methods.name: onPageFinished
methods.description: Updates debug status and home canvas state after page load.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the JSON representing the canvas state on the home view.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates JavaScript code in the WebView context and returns the result.

methods.name: snapshotPngBase64
methods.description: Captures a PNG snapshot of the WebView content and encodes it in Base64.

methods.name: snapshotBase64
methods.description: Captures a snapshot in the specified image format, with optional quality and width constraints, and encodes it in Base64.

methods.name: captureBitmap
methods.description: Helper function to create a bitmap snapshot of the current WebView content.
